inputs.modified_text: A South Portland parent of three is apologizing to school staff as the district faces cuts of more than 70 positions. Families and dedicated employees shouldn’t be made to carry the burden while school leaders avoid explaining how the money was managed. Before taxpayers are asked to pay more, the district owes them clear answers and responsible stewardship. Asking for more funding can’t be the automatic answer to every shortfall.
